chunks.title: Pandas dataframe recap
chunks.text: Okay, in this lesson, we're going to dive into how do we fill a data frame with the data that we want. And we're also going to touch upon a couple issues that we had that were pointed out in the previous lesson. For instance, remember when we had that issue that the dates were actually

chunks.title: Pandas dataframe recap
chunks.text: in the reverse order when we loaded them in? We're going to fix that. We're going to fix a couple other things too. Okay, just to refresh your memory, here's the kind of stuff that goes in a data frame. Our columns are the particular symbols of stocks that we're interested in,

chunks.title: Pandas dataframe recap
chunks.text: and our rows are dates. So time goes from the top of the data frame down to the bottom, and symbols from left to right.
